If you stay home, you get a guaranteed moderate reward (5 points). Action_A represents Going to the Bar. Action_B represents Staying Home.

description:
A unique market opportunity has emerged: an exclusive, high-impact product launch event that promises to redefine our industry. You and 99 other top-tier business strategists must decide simultaneously whether to attend this high-profile summit or focus on established internal projects. If 60 or fewer of you attend, the access and networking opportunities will be unparalleled, offering a significant competitive advantage. However, if more than 60 strategists descend upon the event, the venue will be chaotic and unproductive, rendering your attendance a complete waste of valuable resources and time. Remaining behind to cultivate existing ventures, on the other hand, guarantees a stable and respectable return on investment.

Option A: Dedicate your resources to your current, reliably profitable initiatives.
Option B: Commit to attending the cutting-edge industry summit.
